_comment: MEASURED, NOT GUESSED. Read off x.com's real logged-out login flow on a box (exact-swallow, main, 2026-09-14, DIVE-4538) with the plugin's OWN probe command — google-chrome --headless --dump-dom --virtual-time-budget=8000 on a throwaway profile — and identical at a 25s budget and under Playwright 1.63 after 15s of real time. A plain fetch of this URL returns an app shell with no form at all, so a marker written from curl would never match and would stamp every logged-out page authenticated — the one mutant this file must not carry.

probe._comment: The login flow's first field (<input name="username_or_email" autocomplete="username webauthn">). UNMEASURED HALF: no x.com profile exists on any box (throwaways only, and there is none), so the logged-in render of this URL was not observed. That gap fails SAFE: were a logged-in visitor still shown this field, status would read 'session expired' and name a person — never 'authenticated' on a logged-out page.
